title: Ay alamdare hussain
body:
aah uftade zitan daste alamdare hussain
ay alamdare hussain ay alamdare hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ay behan matame abbas e ali kije bapa
karte thay peet ke sar hazrat e shabbir buka
hogaya qatl mera bhai nahi dil ko chain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
di khabar sheh ne juhin qatl alamdar huwe
chadare gir padi ye sunke haram ke sar se
karti thi aale iba shiddate aalaam se bain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay bahan tere biradar ki kamar toot gayi
bhai ka daagh meri quwwate dil loot gayi
kyun na matam karoo sar peetu karoo ro kar bain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime ke dar pe abhi tak hai sakina zainab
ye khabar sunke na mar jaye hazeena zainab
kis tarha usko batayega ye mazloom e hussain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai kahan zauja e abbas yahan bulwao
pursa hum denge unhe bachon ko bhi le aao
haaye dunya se utha murtuza ka noor e ain
aah uftade zitan daste...
ay alamdare hussain...
